about.title: About {{name}}
about.subtitle: A powerful, modern project management platform designed to help teams collaborate, track progress, and deliver exceptional results.
about.body1: {{name}} is a comprehensive project management solution that empowers teams to work smarter, faster, and more efficiently. Whether you're managing software development projects, coordinating cross-functional teams, or tracking complex workflows, our platform provides the tools you need to succeed.
about.body2: Built with modern technology and user experience in mind, {{name}} combines powerful features with an intuitive interface. From issue tracking to sprint planning, from team management to custom workflows, everything you need is at your fingertips.

projectManagement.title: Project Management
projectManagement.description: Create, organize, and manage multiple projects with ease. Track progress, set deadlines, and collaborate with your team.

issueTracking.title: Issue Tracking
issueTracking.description: Track bugs, tasks, and feature requests. Assign issues to team members, set priorities, and monitor progress.

customWorkflows.title: Custom Workflows
customWorkflows.description: Define custom workflows and status transitions to match your team's unique processes and methodologies.

kanbanBoards.title: Kanban Boards
kanbanBoards.description: Visualize your work with Kanban boards. Drag and drop issues between columns to track progress in real-time.

sprintPlanning.title: Sprint Planning
sprintPlanning.description: Plan and execute sprints efficiently. Organize issues into sprints, track velocity, and manage your agile workflow.

teamCollaboration.title: Team Collaboration
teamCollaboration.description: Manage team members, assign roles, and control permissions. Keep everyone aligned and productive.

about.whyBullet1: Streamline your project management workflow with intuitive tools
about.whyBullet2: Improve team collaboration with real-time updates and notifications
about.whyBullet3: Customize workflows to match your team's unique processes
about.whyBullet4: Track progress and make data-driven decisions
about.getStartedP1: Ready to transform how your team manages projects? Start by creating your first project, invite team members, and begin tracking your work. Our platform is designed to scale with your needs, from small teams to large enterprises.
about.getStartedP2: For administrative tasks, user management, and system configuration, visit the Admin Dashboard to customize your experience.
